art_direction_mandate: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level. Hybrid of Apple/Linear technical precision and Aesop editorial luxury. The design balances massive whitespace, severe typography, and organic kinetic motion. Core features include a masked line-by-line reveal in the hero, spotlight/clipped image treatments for portfolio cases, numbered manifesto chapters, and an editorial marquee.

theme_strategy.support: Light and Dark modes toggled via navigation and stored in localStorage. Seamless transition without reload.

typography.strategy: Editorial Future (Wide Display Sans + Geometric Body) mixed with luxury serif accents.

fonts.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Clash Display (sans-serif) for primary impact. Alternative: Playfair Display for luxury sections.
fonts.body: Outfit or Manrope (sans-serif) for strict geometric legibility.
fonts.accents: Cormorant Garamond (italic serif) for quote marks, ampersands, or specific accent words in headings.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk for headings.
Headings must have tight letter spacing (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter).
Hierarchy gap rule: H1 and subtitle must have at least 2 Tailwind steps between them.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates (py-24 to py-32 for sections).

grids.marketing_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetrical distribution (e.g., col-span-8 for hero images, col-span-4 for text blocks).
grids.cms_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Dense, strict hierarchy. Use border-collapse styles for technical look.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), 1px delicate inner stroke.
surfaces.cards: Subtle, flat backgrounds with 1px border. On hover, elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast soft ambient shadow.
surfaces.images: Spotlight/clipped frames. Do not round corners fully—use sharp or very slight radii (rounded-sm) for a brutalist/editorial edge.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire marketing site body to eliminate digital flatness.

motion.hero_kinetic: Masked line-by-line reveal. Text wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, animating Y from 100% to 0% with easeOut.
motion.scroll_reveal: Elements fade in and translate up (y: 30) when in view via Framer Motion's whileInView.
motion.parallax: Subtle image parallax using Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform for hero and featured portfolio images.
motion.interactions: Button hover: pill-shaped, scale up slightly, or background slide. Cards: border color shift and soft lift.
motion.marquee: Slow, editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Huge outline text or spaced serif text.

marketing_pages.structure: Raw HTML + Tailwind CSS. Avoid pre-built Shadcn layouts for high-impact sections to ensure asymmetry.
marketing_pages.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Textarea/Select for logic and accessibility, but restyle heavily (e.g., bottom border only, flush background).

cms_admin.structure: Strictly Shadcn components. Dense, practical, highly usable.
cms_admin.components: Tables, Dialogs, Cards, Forms, Dropdowns, Tabs.
cms_admin.styling: Cardless or subtle rounded corners. Use sharp edges.

media.3d_parallax: React Spring Parallax or Framer Motion 3D for subtle shifts. No heavy Three.js unless specifically building an interactive object.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text hits 4.5:1 on background. Validate the accent blue (#2563EB and #3B82F6) against surfaces.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations with useReducedMotion checks where necessary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, forms, CMS actions) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: Scaffold standard React app. Configure Tailwind with Light/Dark mode classes and defined color palette.
Step 2: Install dependencies: framer-motion, lenis (for smooth scroll), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, and required Shadcn components.
Step 3: Build the Marketing Layout. Implement Nav (crystal glassmorphism) and Footer (massive space, large branding). Implement theme toggle.
Step 4: Build Home Page. Execute the Kinetic Hero (line-by-line reveal), Manifesto Chapters, Marquee, Portfolio Grid with Parallax images.
Step 5: Build subsequent Marketing Pages (About, Services, Portfolio, Case Studies, Blog, Contact). Use the image URLs provided in media.image_urls.
Step 6: Build the Admin CMS Dashboard. Use a tight sidebar layout, Shadcn tables for data, and simple minimal cards for metrics.
Step 7: Final Polish. Add subtle grain overlay globally. Ensure all interactive components have focus states and smooth hover micro-animations.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds without a blur or scrim in the header or dropdowns.
Avoid generic, centered 'AI slop' layouts. Rely on asymmetry and tension in marketing pages.
Implement layering with robust z-index usage.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transition properties (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
DO NOT force text-align: center on the root App container.
Never use placeholder URLs (like placehold.it). Use the supplied image URLs.
